mapper.select: SELECT c.idColaborador AS idColaborador, c.nombre, c.apellidoPaterno AS apellidoPaterno, c.apellidoMaterno AS apellidoMaterno, c.curp, c.correo, c.numeroPersonal AS numeroPersonal, c.password, c.numeroLicencia AS numeroLicencia, c.idRol AS idRol, r.nombre AS rol, c.idSucursal AS idSucursal, TO_BASE64(c.foto) AS fotoBase64 FROM colaborador c INNER JOIN rol r ON r.idRol = c.idRol WHERE c.numeroPersonal = #{numeroPersonal} AND c.password = #{password}
